rationale: Kept interface/filters but retuned for +3-4 s extra dead-time: predictor horizon 5->6 s, Kp 0.50->0.75 on predicted error with tighter clamp, Kd 0.45->1.0 for phase lead, Ki 0.10->0.07 with 0.015 deadband and predictor-aware anti-windup, stricter s_max schedule (0.90/0.75/0.60/0.45/0.30), asymmetric slew (up 0.25/s, down 0.40/s for fast cut), and slow adaptive feedforward uff init 0.62 clamp 0.35-0.85 adapting 0.05*err*dt only when |err|<0.09 and |rf|<0.007. This cuts pump 2-3 s earlier on predicted overshoot and lets integrator+bias learn hold for both nominal and delayed plant without windup limit-cycle.

extra.machine_card: Delayed reservoir: dead-time ~4.5-5.5 s (was ~1-2 s), dominant tau ~8-10 s (was ~3-4 s), static gain ~0.045 level/s per unit u, hold for y=0.6 ~0.62-0.70 (adapts), drain ~0.025/s at y~0.6 u=0, noise sigma <0.02, hard cutoff 0.9, keep y<0.75 for margin. Controller uses Tp=6 s predictor, Kp=0.75/Kd=1.0/Ki=0.07, uff~0.62 adaptive.
extra.predicted_behavior: From 0.15-0.38 starts at u~0.90, reaches 0.55 by ~18-24 s, peaks 0.63-0.68 (no >0.75), returns to 0.55-0.65 and stays: in_band after 30 s >=0.75 (target 0.70 gate), MAE ~0.030-0.045 (was 0.06-0.11), energy ~48-53 (similar or lower), zero overrides/hard violations. Nominal plant: same settles slightly faster with smaller peak ~0.63. Delayed plant: no sustained 40 s cycle, residual ripple +/-0.02 from noise only.
extra.diagnosis: Response is slower/longer dead-time, not weaker gain. E2 at u=1.0: 0.177->0.184 in 1 s (+0.007) and E6 at u=0.8: 0.203->0.235 in 2 s, lag ~1-2 s. Evaluated v1-ep1 at u=0.92: 0.179 at 0 s stays 0.14-0.16 for 4 s, first rise at 4.8 s (0.164) strong only after 5.6 s (0.189), lag ~4-5 s. Post-lag slope similar: nominal ~0.019-0.028/s vs evaluated 0.021-0.026/s (6.4-14.4 s segments), so K ~0.045/s per u unchanged. Extra 3-4 s delay with Td=5 under-compensation explains overshoot to 0.73-0.81, undershoot to 0.43-0.52, sustained ~35-45 s limit cycle, in_band 0.34-0.36 MAE ~0.06 and v2 MAE 0.11. Drain at u~0.3 ~0.022/s vs nominal ~0.011-0.015/s is explained by higher average level plus delay, not 2x leak. No sensor bias (mean tracks target) and noise still <0.02.
